top_choice_rationale: P001 (Cullis, Hope, Madden; ionizable lipid nanoparticles) turns lipid polymorphism, pH-tuned headgroup charge and rapid-mixing self-assembly into a stated design rule, with full maturity (approved siRNA therapy, mRNA vaccines, many independent replications) and a three-name credit that fits the decisive Vancouver line. Its citation is about the vehicle chemistry, distinct from the 2023 Medicine prize for nucleoside modification. Car-Parrinello (P004) is second as a clean two-name conceptual method, then perovskites (P002), whose stability and lead questions and Gratzel/Seok/Kanatzidis credit gaps weigh on timing; sequencing (P003) and C-N coupling (P005, a sequel to 2010) follow, with no award last.
recusal_note: Field closeness to lipid self-assembly and membrane physical chemistry could bear on P001; Lund colleagues Linke and Somfai sit on the committee, but no direct connection to the proposed laureates is apparent from profile.
